event.title: South Africa's Deputy Police Chief Resigns Amid Sexual Offense Charges
event.canonical_title: South Africa's Deputy Police Chief Resigns Amid Sexual Offense Charges
event.summary: Shadrack Sibiya has resigned from his position as South Africa's deputy police chief following serious allegations, including charges of sexual offenses. He has denied accusations of grooming a 16-year-old and raping an 18-year-old. Sibiya was previously suspended amid corruption allegations.
